NO_GO · DO_NOT_RECOMMEND

Expired-access logout leaves valid refresh credentials usable in the isolated current controller test. A holder of copied credentials could regain authentication after apparent logout.

Action: authentication and security owners must correct the failure or prove it inapplicable, then reassess.
